model_output.verdict: A commercial construction project manager whose project values, trade counts and schedule results are easy to see.
write_up: This is a strong construction project manager resume! At Capitol Builders, you show the value and number of projects you run, the trades you manage and a grocery build delivered ahead of schedule. A recruiter can see the work and its scale without guessing.

The grocery store line is the model: it names the build, its value and the schedule result. Your move from Assistant Project Manager to Project Manager is easy to follow, and Experience is right where it belongs, above Education.

I'd add how you kept change orders low, if you can point to your part in that work. Otherwise, your resume is unlikely to be the reason you don't get a call back; competition for the particular job matters too.
